summary: Preinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to Burp Collaborator endpoint
details: The package's preinstall hook runs index.js, which collects hostname, platform, architecture, home directory, and DNS server list via the Node os module and POSTs the JSON payload over HTTPS to the hardcoded host 367qobrcgbi1dvqrghhhpvham1stgr4g.oastify.com at path /hit. The endpoint is a Burp Collaborator subdomain, an out-of-band interaction server commonly used as a dependency-confusion / reconnaissance beacon. The exfiltration fires automatically on npm install with no opt-in, and the collected fields identify the installer host and its internal network configuration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
